upright.general: Represents multiple options, dreams, fantasies, and uncertainty. A person may feel overwhelmed by possibilities or struggle to distinguish reality from illusion.
upright.in_love: Idealization of a partner, romantic fantasies, or confusion in relationships. There may be unrealistic expectations or emotional indecision.
upright.in_situation: A situation with too many choices or unclear directions. Requires grounding and careful evaluation before committing.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today may bring many options, fantasies, or distractions. It is important to separate real opportunities from illusions and unclear desires before making decisions.
upright.card_advice: Do not rush into choices based on emotions or imagination alone. Focus on clarity, prioritize what is realistic, and avoid being overwhelmed by too many possibilities.

reversed.general: Indicates clarity after confusion, making a firm decision, and seeing reality as it is. It can also warn against harsh truth or disappointment.
reversed.in_love: Realistic understanding of a partner or relationship. Clearing illusions leads to either commitment or moving on.
reversed.in_situation: A turning point where confusion resolves and a clear direction is chosen. Focus returns after distraction.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today may bring mental clarity, realistic thinking, and the ability to finally make an important decision. Confusion begins to fade, allowing you to see situations and people more honestly.
reversed.card_advice: Trust facts more than fantasies and focus your energy on one clear direction. Let go of unrealistic expectations and make choices based on truth, practicality, and inner confidence.
